_RenderMode.label: Render Mode
_RenderMode.tooltip: Controls how the shader is rendered. Opaque is fastest. Cutout is for hard-edged transparency. Transparent is for soft, blended effects.

_PerformanceLevel.label: Performance Level
_PerformanceLevel.tooltip: Sets a performance baseline, disabling expensive features at lower levels.

_ZWrite.label: Force Depth Write (ZWrite)
_ZWrite.tooltip: Manually control if this material writes to the depth buffer. Enable this for transparent objects that should still occlude objects behind them.

_Cutoff.label: Alpha Cutoff
_Cutoff.tooltip: The alpha threshold for the cutout effect.

_UseUVTileDiscard.label: UV Tile Discard
_UseUVTileDiscard.tooltip: Discard specific UV tiles. Useful for toggling clothing parts.

_BaseColor.label: Color
_BaseColor.tooltip: The main color of the hologram when not using a texture.

_UseVertexColors.label: Use Vertex Colors
_UseVertexColors.tooltip: Tints the shader using colors painted onto the model’s vertices. Requires a model with vertex colors.

_VertexColorAlphaAsOpacity.label: Alpha As Opacity
_VertexColorAlphaAsOpacity.tooltip: Uses vertex color alpha channel as an opacity multiplier.

_UseEmission.label: Enable Emission
_UseEmission.tooltip: Makes the object glow. Requires a Bloom post-processing effect in the scene to see the glow.

_UseEmissionPulse.label: Enable Emission Pulse
_UseEmissionPulse.tooltip: Pulses emission intensity rhythmically without affecting diffuse lighting.

_EmissionPulseSpeed.label: Pulse Speed
_EmissionPulseSpeed.tooltip: Speed of the pulsing emission animation.

_EmissionPulseIntensity.label: Pulse Intensity
_EmissionPulseIntensity.tooltip: How much the emission pulses (0 = no pulse, 1 = full pulse from 0 to max strength).

_UseVertexColorForEmission.label: Use Vertex Color For Emission
_UseVertexColorForEmission.tooltip: Uses the RGB channels of vertex colors to tint the emission glow.

_UseAlphaToEmission.label: Use Texture Alpha for Emission
_UseAlphaToEmission.tooltip: Uses the main texture’s alpha channel as an emission map. A powerful way to create glow maps without a separate texture.

_AlphaEmissionStrength.label: Strength
_AlphaEmissionStrength.tooltip: How much alpha affects emission (higher values glow brighter).

_EmissionStrength.label: Emission Strength
_EmissionStrength.tooltip: How bright the glowing effect is.

_UseEmission2.label: Enable 2nd Emission
_UseEmission2.tooltip: Adds a second scrolling emission layer.

_UseEmission3.label: Enable 3rd Emission
_UseEmission3.tooltip: Adds a third scrolling emission layer.

_UseEmission4.label: Enable 4th Emission
_UseEmission4.tooltip: Adds a fourth scrolling emission layer.

_UseProceduralTexture.label: Enable Procedural Texture
_UseProceduralTexture.tooltip: Replaces a material property with a generated pattern.

_ProceduralColor1.label: Color 1
_ProceduralColor1.tooltip: The first color of the procedural pattern.

_ProceduralColor2.label: Color 2
_ProceduralColor2.tooltip: The second color of the procedural pattern.

_ProceduralScale.label: Scale
_ProceduralScale.tooltip: Controls the size/tiling of the pattern.

_ProceduralSpeed.label: Speed
_ProceduralSpeed.tooltip: Controls the animation speed of the pattern.

_ProceduralThickness.label: Thickness
_ProceduralThickness.tooltip: The thickness of the pattern lines.

_ProceduralDensity.label: Density
_ProceduralDensity.tooltip: Controls the size of the pattern elements. Higher values increase the size.

_ProceduralSparsity.label: Sparsity
_ProceduralSparsity.tooltip: Controls the distance between elements in the pattern. Higher values increase the spacing.

_ProceduralRotation.label: Rotation
_ProceduralRotation.tooltip: Rotates the entire procedural pattern. A value of 0.125 is 45 degrees.

_NoiseOctaves.label: Octaves
_NoiseOctaves.tooltip: Adds layers of noise at different scales to create much more detailed and natural patterns.

_NoiseLacunarity.label: Lacunarity
_NoiseLacunarity.tooltip: Controls how the frequency of the noise changes with each octave.

_NoiseGain.label: Gain
_NoiseGain.tooltip: Controls how the amplitude of the noise changes with each octave.

_VoronoiStyle.label: Style
_VoronoiStyle.tooltip: Controls the visual style of the Voronoi pattern.

_AnimSpeedMultiplier.label: Global Speed Multiplier
_AnimSpeedMultiplier.tooltip: Master animation speed multiplier. Animate this via VRChat Avatar Dynamics / Animator parameters to control or freeze all shader procedural animations.

_UseAdvancedAnim.label: Enable Advanced Animation Controls
_UseAdvancedAnim.tooltip: Exposes master controls for time scaling, playback mode, and time offset for all shader animations.

_AnimTimeScale.label: Time Scale
_AnimTimeScale.tooltip: Controls the overall speed of all shader animations. Can be used to slow down or speed up effects.

_AnimPlayMode.label: Playback Mode
_AnimPlayMode.tooltip: Sets the global playback mode. 0 = Loop (restarts from beginning), 1 = Ping-Pong (reverses direction).

_AnimOffset.label: Time Offset
_AnimOffset.tooltip: Applies a global time offset to all animations, useful for synchronizing or de-synchronizing effects.

_TwoSidedLighting.label: Two-Sided Lighting
_TwoSidedLighting.tooltip: Flips normal direction on back faces for correct two-sided illumination when Cull is Off.

_UseSpecularAA.label: Enable Specular AA
_UseSpecularAA.tooltip: Anti-aliases specular highlights, reducing shimmering and flickering on glossy surfaces.

_UseOpenLitMath.label: OpenLit Harmony Mode
_UseOpenLitMath.tooltip: Use OpenLit CC0 standard half-Lambert diffuse math for consistent lighting across crowd avatars in photo worlds.

_SpecularAAVariance.label: Variance
_SpecularAAVariance.tooltip: Controls how aggressively the AA blurring is applied.

_SpecularAAThreshold.label: Threshold
_SpecularAAThreshold.tooltip: The threshold for specular highlight intensity before AA kicks in.

_ShadowColor.label: Shadow Color
_ShadowColor.tooltip: The color of the areas not hit by light.

_ToonThreshold.label: Threshold
_ToonThreshold.tooltip: The size of the lit area in Toon mode.

_ToonHardness.label: Hardness
_ToonHardness.tooltip: The sharpness of the shadow edge in Toon mode.

_ToonShadowBorder.label: Shadow Border
_ToonShadowBorder.tooltip: Offsets the Toon shadow line boundary.

_ToonShadowBlur.label: Shadow Blur
_ToonShadowBlur.tooltip: Softens the Toon shadow step blur.

_ToonShadowAO.label: AO Shadow Modulation
_ToonShadowAO.tooltip: Modulates the cel shadow boundary using the ambient occlusion map.

_NormalMap.label: Normal Map
_NormalMap.tooltip: Adds surface detail using a normal map.

_BumpScale.label: Normal Scale
_BumpScale.tooltip: Strength and depth of the surface normal bumps.

_USE_DETAIL_NORMAL_ON.label: Enable Detail Normal Map
_USE_DETAIL_NORMAL_ON.tooltip: Adds a secondary normal map for micro-surface detail bumps.

_DetailNormalMap.label: Detail Normal Map
_DetailNormalMap.tooltip: A second normal map overlaid on the base normal for added surface detail.

_DetailNormalScale.label: Detail Normal Strength
_DetailNormalScale.tooltip: Controls the strength of the detail normal map.

_NormalBlendMode.label: Normal Blend Mode
_NormalBlendMode.tooltip: Blending algorithm between base and detail normal maps (Whiteout vs Reoriented Normal Mapping / RNM).

_MetallicGlossMap.label: Metallic (R) Smoothness (A)
_MetallicGlossMap.tooltip: Metallic (R) and Smoothness (A) map. (Note: Smoothness is ignored if a separate Roughness Map is provided)

_Metallic.label: Metallic
_Metallic.tooltip: Controls how metallic the surface is (0 = dielectric/plastic, 1 = pure metal).

_Glossiness.label: Smoothness
_Glossiness.tooltip: Controls how smooth and reflective the surface is (0 = rough/matte, 1 = mirror smooth).

_UseAmbientLighting.label: Use Ambient Lighting
_UseAmbientLighting.tooltip: Toggles sampling of scene ambient light and reflection probes. Makes lighting more consistent across different worlds.

_UseSHAmbient.label: Use High Quality Ambient (SH)
_UseSHAmbient.tooltip: Enable high-quality Spherical Harmonics ambient. Note: Forced OFF in Medium/Low performance levels.

_AmbientFallbackMode.label: Ambient Fallback Mode
_AmbientFallbackMode.tooltip: Selects the fallback lighting model when High Quality SH is disabled or turned off.

_UseLightOverride.label: Override Scene Light
_UseLightOverride.tooltip: Overrides the direction, color, and intensity of the main scene light.

_ShadowStrength.label: Shadow Strength
_ShadowStrength.tooltip: Strength multiplier of shadows cast from this light.

_RampTex.label: Toon Ramp
_RampTex.tooltip: Toon Ramp texture. Transitions shadow (left) to light (right).

_ToonToneCount.label: Tone Count
_ToonToneCount.tooltip: Number of discrete shading quantization bands for Toon lighting.

_MidThreshold.label: Mid Threshold
_MidThreshold.tooltip: Threshold boundary for the midtone band.

_HighlightThreshold.label: Highlight Threshold
_HighlightThreshold.tooltip: Threshold boundary for the highlight band.

_SpecularMode.label: Workflow
_SpecularMode.tooltip: Selects between Metallic-Smoothness and Specular-Color PBR lighting workflows.

_ShadowmaskFallbackMode.label: Shadowmask Fallback
_ShadowmaskFallbackMode.tooltip: Fallback behavior when shadowmask textures are unavailable.

_OcclusionMap.label: Occlusion Map (G)
_OcclusionMap.tooltip: Occlusion Map (G) to bake shadows in crevices.

_OcclusionStrength.label: Occlusion Strength
_OcclusionStrength.tooltip: Strength of ambient shadow crevices from the occlusion map.

_DetailMask.label: Detail Mask (A)
_DetailMask.tooltip: Detail Mask (A) to restrict the application of secondary Detail Texture.

_UseSSS.label: Enable Subsurface Scattering
_UseSSS.tooltip: Simulates light scattering through thin objects like skin or leaves.

_SSS_Scale.label: Scale
_SSS_Scale.tooltip: The overall strength of the SSS effect.

_SSS_Radius.label: Radius
_SSS_Radius.tooltip: How far light scatters within the material.

_SSS_Color.label: Tint
_SSS_Color.tooltip: The color tint applied to the scattered light.

_USE_THICKNESS_MAP_ON.label: Enable Thickness Map
_USE_THICKNESS_MAP_ON.tooltip: Uses a texture to simulate light transmission through thin areas (ears, leaves, etc.).

_ThicknessMap.label: Thickness Map (R)
_ThicknessMap.tooltip: Thickness Map (R channel). White = thick (no transmission), Black = thin (full transmission).

_ThicknessStrength.label: Thickness Strength
_ThicknessStrength.tooltip: Controls the intensity of the backlight transmission effect.

_UseSSSTransmissionTex.label: Use SSS Transmission Texture
_UseSSSTransmissionTex.tooltip: Custom color map tinting the backlight transmission.

_UseAnisotropy.label: Enable Anisotropic Reflection
_UseAnisotropy.tooltip: Creates stretched highlights, common on brushed metal or hair.

_Aniso_Strength.label: Specular Strength
_Aniso_Strength.tooltip: The overall brightness of the anisotropic highlight.

_Aniso_TangentMap.label: Tangent Map (optional)
_Aniso_TangentMap.tooltip: A tangent map (RG channels) to control the direction of the anisotropic highlights.

_UseClearCoat.label: Enable Clear Coat
_UseClearCoat.tooltip: Adds a secondary clear coat specular layer over the base PBR material. Useful for painted/coated surfaces.

_ClearCoatStrength.label: Clear Coat Strength
_ClearCoatStrength.tooltip: Intensity of the secondary automotive lacquer / resin clearcoat layer.

_ClearCoatRoughness.label: Clear Coat Roughness
_ClearCoatRoughness.tooltip: Roughness of the secondary clearcoat layer.

_USE_EYE_REFRACTION_ON.label: Enable Eye Iris Parallax
_USE_EYE_REFRACTION_ON.tooltip: Simulates depth/refraction of the pupil and iris beneath the cornea.

_IrisTiling.label: Iris UV Tiling
_IrisTiling.tooltip: Controls the tiling of the iris texture.

_PupilSize.label: Pupil Scale
_PupilSize.tooltip: Controls the size scale of the pupil.

_USE_SKIN_WRAP_ON.label: Enable Skin Diffuse Wrap
_USE_SKIN_WRAP_ON.tooltip: Softens lighting shadows on organic curved surfaces.

_SkinWrapAmount.label: Wrap Amount
_SkinWrapAmount.tooltip: How much light wraps around the shadow terminator.

_USE_HAIR_SPEC_ON.label: Enable Hair Anisotropic Specular (Kajiya-Kay)
_USE_HAIR_SPEC_ON.tooltip: Anisotropic highlights styled specifically for hair strands.

_HairSpecColor.label: Specular Color
_HairSpecColor.tooltip: Color of the hair specular highlights.

_HairSpecExponent2.label: Secondary Exponent
_HairSpecExponent2.tooltip: Sharpness of the secondary shifted highlight.

_HairSpecShift.label: Specular Shift
_HairSpecShift.tooltip: Position shift along the hair direction.

_UseGrid.label: Enable Grid
_UseGrid.tooltip: Overlays a grid pattern on the surface.

_GridMode.label: Grid Pattern
_GridMode.tooltip: Procedural grid style (Square, Hexagonal, Radial, Wireframe).

_GridColor.label: Color
_GridColor.tooltip: The color of the grid lines.

_GridColor_Shift.label: Grid Color Shift
_GridColor_Shift.tooltip: AudioLink or animated color shift for procedural grid lines.

_GridSparsity.label: Sparsity
_GridSparsity.tooltip: Controls the distance between elements in the pattern. Higher values increase the spacing.

_GridSpace.label: Coordinate Space
_GridSpace.tooltip: Coordinate space for procedural grid mapping (Object UV, Local Mesh, World Space).

_GridThickness.label: Grid Line Thickness
_GridThickness.tooltip: Line thickness for procedural grid overlay.

_GridScrollSpeed.label: Scroll Speed X
_GridScrollSpeed.tooltip: How fast the grid scrolls along its first axis (world X).

_GridRotation.label: Rotation
_GridRotation.tooltip: Rotates the entire grid pattern. A value of 0.125 is 45 degrees.

_GridScrollSpeedY.label: Scroll Speed Y
_GridScrollSpeedY.tooltip: How fast the grid scrolls along its second axis (world Z).

_BoxFractalIsFill.label: Use Fill Style
_BoxFractalIsFill.tooltip: Switches the Box Fractal between a fill pattern and an outline pattern.

_GridPatternIsFill.label: Use Fill Style
_GridPatternIsFill.tooltip: Switches the pattern between a fill and an outline.

_MandelboxIsFill.label: Use Fill Style
_MandelboxIsFill.tooltip: Switches the Mandelbox between a fill pattern and an outline pattern.

_GridPulseMode.label: Grid Pulse Mode
_GridPulseMode.tooltip: Grid animation pulse waveform (Sine, Triangle, AudioLink).

_GridPulseSpeed.label: Pulse Speed
_GridPulseSpeed.tooltip: The speed of the pulse animation.

_GridPulseIntensity.label: Pulse Intensity
_GridPulseIntensity.tooltip: The strength of the pulse effect.

_GridPulseMin.label: Grid Pulse Min
_GridPulseMin.tooltip: Minimum grid brightness/thickness multiplier during pulsing.

_GridPulseMax.label: Grid Pulse Max
_GridPulseMax.tooltip: Maximum grid brightness/thickness multiplier during pulsing.

_UseGridDepthColor.label: Use Depth-Based Color
_UseGridDepthColor.tooltip: Changes the grid color based on its proximity to other surfaces.

_GridDepthColor.label: Depth Color
_GridDepthColor.tooltip: The color the grid shifts to when near a surface.

_GridDepthRange.label: Depth Range
_GridDepthRange.tooltip: The distance over which the color change occurs.

_UseGridMask.label: Use Grid Mask
_UseGridMask.tooltip: Uses a texture to mask the grid effect.

_GridMask.label: Grid Mask
_GridMask.tooltip: The texture used to mask the grid. The red channel is used.

_InvertGridMask.label: Invert Mask
_InvertGridMask.tooltip: Inverts the mask, so black areas are visible and white areas are hidden.

_USE_DISTORTION_ON.label: Enable Vertex Distortion
_USE_DISTORTION_ON.tooltip: Toggles procedural vertex distortion animation on or off.

_DistortionMode.label: Distortion Mode
_DistortionMode.tooltip: Procedural vertex distortion algorithm (Sine wave, Noise turbulence, Flapping, etc.).

_DistortionStrength.label: Strength
_DistortionStrength.tooltip: How far the vertices are displaced.

_DistortionSpeed.label: Speed
_DistortionSpeed.tooltip: The speed of the distortion animation.

_DistortionTex.label: Distortion Texture (RG for offset)
_DistortionTex.tooltip: A texture to control the distortion (R=X offset, G=Z offset).

_StretchAxis.label: Stretch Axis
_StretchAxis.tooltip: Mesh axis along which procedural vertex stretching applies.

_WindDirection.label: Direction
_WindDirection.tooltip: The local-space direction of the wind (relative to the object).

_WindScale.label: Scale
_WindScale.tooltip: The size of the wind gusts. Smaller values create larger, slower waves.

_FlapScale.label: Scale
_FlapScale.tooltip: Controls the curvature or 'waviness' of the flapping motion.

_FlapPhaseOffset.label: Phase Offset
_FlapPhaseOffset.tooltip: Adds a time delay to one side, creating an asymmetrical flap. 0 is symmetrical.

_FlapMode.label: Flap Mode
_FlapMode.tooltip: Direction and style of vertex flapping animation (Wings, Flags, Foliage).

_FlapPivot.label: Flap Pivot
_FlapPivot.tooltip: Anchor point/pivot position for vertex flapping oscillation.

_FlapDirection.label: Direction
_FlapDirection.tooltip: A vector that defines the custom local-space direction for the flapping motion.

_USE_DISSOLVE_ON.label: Enable Dissolve
_USE_DISSOLVE_ON.tooltip: Makes the object appear/disappear using a noise pattern.

_DissolveMode.label: Dissolve Mode
_DissolveMode.tooltip: Selects the dissolve math algorithm (Linear, Radial, Spherical, Voronoi noise, etc.).

_DissolveScale.label: Scale
_DissolveScale.tooltip: Controls the size/spread of the dissolve effect.

_DissolveDirection.label: Direction
_DissolveDirection.tooltip: The world-space direction the dissolve wave travels.

_DissolveOrigin.label: World Origin
_DissolveOrigin.tooltip: The world-space center point from which the dissolve emanates.

_DissolveOriginIsObject.label: Use Object Center
_DissolveOriginIsObject.tooltip: When enabled, the dissolve originates from the object’s pivot point. When disabled, it uses a fixed world-space coordinate.

_DissolveMap.label: Dissolve Noise Map
_DissolveMap.tooltip: The noise texture used for the dissolve effect (uses the red channel).

_DissolveProjMode.label: Dissolve Map Projection Mode
_DissolveProjMode.tooltip: UV projection mapping mode for the dissolve texture.

_DissolveAmount.label: Amount
_DissolveAmount.tooltip: The progress of the dissolve effect (0-1).

_DissolveEdgeWidth.label: Edge Width
_DissolveEdgeWidth.tooltip: The width of the glowing edge on the dissolve line.

_DissolveGlitchBlockSize.label: Block Size
_DissolveGlitchBlockSize.tooltip: The size of the glitch blocks in screen space.

_DissolveEdgeColor.label: Edge Color
_DissolveEdgeColor.tooltip: The color of the glowing dissolve edge.

_DissolveEdgeColor_Shift.label: Edge Color Shift
_DissolveEdgeColor_Shift.tooltip: AudioLink or animated color shift for the dissolve burning edge.

_UseDissolveGradient.label: Use Gradient
_UseDissolveGradient.tooltip: Uses a gradient texture to color the dissolve edge instead of a solid color.

_UseAdvancedDissolveAnim.label: Use Advanced Timing
_UseAdvancedDissolveAnim.tooltip: Use custom timing for the dissolve animation instead of a simple loop/ping-pong.

_DissolveOnDuration.label: Dissolve On Duration
_DissolveOnDuration.tooltip: The time it takes for the dissolve-in animation to play.

_DissolveVisibleDuration.label: Visible Duration
_DissolveVisibleDuration.tooltip: The time the object remains fully visible (at max dissolve).

_DissolveOffDuration.label: Dissolve Off Duration
_DissolveOffDuration.tooltip: The time it takes for the dissolve-out animation to play.

_DissolveHiddenDuration.label: Hidden Duration
_DissolveHiddenDuration.tooltip: The time the object remains fully hidden (at min dissolve).

_DissolveGradient.label: Dissolve Gradient
_DissolveGradient.tooltip: The color ramp for the dissolve edge. The gradient is mapped across the width of the edge.

_AnimateDissolve.label: Animate
_AnimateDissolve.tooltip: Automatically animates the dissolve amount over time.

_DissolveAnimMode.label: Use Ping-Pong
_DissolveAnimMode.tooltip: If enabled, the animation will play forwards and then backwards. If disabled, it will loop.

_DissolveAnimMin.label: Animation Min
_DissolveAnimMin.tooltip: Minimum dissolve cutoff when animation is enabled.

_DissolveAnimMax.label: Animation Max
_DissolveAnimMax.tooltip: Maximum dissolve cutoff when animation is enabled.

_UsePlanarWipe.label: Enable Planar Wipe
_UsePlanarWipe.tooltip: Reveals the object with a smooth, directional wipe.

_WipeDirection.label: Direction
_WipeDirection.tooltip: The direction the wipe travels across the object.

_WipeProgress.label: Progress
_WipeProgress.tooltip: The progress of the wipe effect.

_WipeHardness.label: Hardness
_WipeHardness.tooltip: The sharpness of the wipe’s edge.

_AnimateWipe.label: Animate Wipe
_AnimateWipe.tooltip: Automatically animates the wipe progress over time.

_UseAdvancedWipeAnim.label: Use Advanced Timing
_UseAdvancedWipeAnim.tooltip: Use custom timing for the wipe animation instead of a simple loop/ping-pong.

_WipeOnDuration.label: Wipe On Duration
_WipeOnDuration.tooltip: The time it takes for the wipe-on animation to play.

_WipeVisibleDuration.label: Visible Duration
_WipeVisibleDuration.tooltip: The time the object remains fully visible.

_WipeOffDuration.label: Wipe Off Duration
_WipeOffDuration.tooltip: The time it takes for the wipe-off animation to play.

_WipeHiddenDuration.label: Hidden Duration
_WipeHiddenDuration.tooltip: The time the object remains fully hidden before looping.

_WipeAnimMode.label: Use Ping-Pong
_WipeAnimMode.tooltip: If enabled, the animation will play forwards and then backwards. If disabled, it will loop.

_Alpha.label: Alpha
_Alpha.tooltip: Controls overall transparency. 1 = fully opaque, 0 = completely invisible.

_UseFresnelTransparency.label: Enable Fresnel Transparency
_UseFresnelTransparency.tooltip: Makes the object more transparent in the center and opaque at the edges.

_FresnelPower.label: Power
_FresnelPower.tooltip: Controls the falloff curve. Higher values push transparency toward edges.

_UseVideoPlayer.label: Video Player Mode
_UseVideoPlayer.tooltip: Configures the texture to receive video player data.

_VideoIsAVPro.label: Is AVPro Video
_VideoIsAVPro.tooltip: Check this if the video player is using AVPro.

_Rotation.label: Rotation
_Rotation.tooltip: Rotates all textures around the center of the UV space.

_USE_PINGPONG_SCROLL_ON.label: Use Ping-Pong Scroll
_USE_PINGPONG_SCROLL_ON.tooltip: Switches the scrolling mode to a back-and-forth ping-pong motion.

_PingPongScrollSpeed.label: Speed
_PingPongScrollSpeed.tooltip: Speed of the back-and-forth scroll motion.

_PingPongScrollRange.label: Range
_PingPongScrollRange.tooltip: Distance of the back-and-forth scroll motion.

_USE_UVDISTORT_ON.label: Enable UV Distortion
_USE_UVDISTORT_ON.tooltip: Uses a texture to warp the UV coordinates, creating effects like heat haze or water ripples.

_UVDistortionMap.label: UV Distortion Map
_UVDistortionMap.tooltip: The texture used to distort the UVs. The Red and Green channels control the X and Y offset.

_UVDistortionStrength.label: Strength
_UVDistortionStrength.tooltip: How intense the UV distortion wobble is.

_UVDistortionSpeedX.label: Speed X
_UVDistortionSpeedX.tooltip: Horizontal speed of the distortion wave.

_UVDistortionSpeedY.label: Speed Y
_UVDistortionSpeedY.tooltip: Vertical speed of the distortion wave.

_USE_FLIPBOOK_ON.label: Enable Flipbook Animation
_USE_FLIPBOOK_ON.tooltip: Animates the main texture using a spritesheet layout. This will override the main texture’s tiling and offset.

_FlipbookColumns.label: Columns (X)
_FlipbookColumns.tooltip: The number of columns (frames horizontally) in the spritesheet.

_FlipbookRows.label: Rows (Y)
_FlipbookRows.tooltip: The number of rows (frames vertically) in the spritesheet.

_FlipbookSpeed.label: Speed (FPS)
_FlipbookSpeed.tooltip: The animation speed in frames per second.

_FlipbookStartFrame.label: Start Frame
_FlipbookStartFrame.tooltip: The starting frame of the animation, allowing for an offset.

_USE_DETAIL_TEX_ON.label: Use Detail Texture
_USE_DETAIL_TEX_ON.tooltip: Overlays a secondary texture, often for fine detail or grunge.

_DetailIntensity.label: Intensity
_DetailIntensity.tooltip: How strongly the detail texture is blended.

_USE_EMISSION_MASK_ON.label: Use Emission Mask
_USE_EMISSION_MASK_ON.tooltip: Uses a texture to control which parts of the surface emit light.

_EmissionMaskTex.label: Emission Mask
_EmissionMaskTex.tooltip: A texture to control emission (white=full emission, black=no emission).

_USE_PARALLAX_ON.label: Enable Parallax Mapping
_USE_PARALLAX_ON.tooltip: Uses a height map to offset UVs for depth.

_HeightMap.label: Height Map (R)
_HeightMap.tooltip: A grayscale texture where white is high and black is low.

_ParallaxStrength.label: Strength
_ParallaxStrength.tooltip: How deep the parallax effect appears.

_USE_POM_ON.label: Enable Parallax Occlusion Mapping
_USE_POM_ON.tooltip: Enables multi-step parallax for higher quality depth effect. High perf only.

_POMMinSteps.label: Min Steps
_POMMinSteps.tooltip: Minimum number of parallax steps (at glancing angles).

_USE_ENV_REFLECTION_ON.label: Enable Environment Reflections
_USE_ENV_REFLECTION_ON.tooltip: Samples reflection probes to add environmental reflections, even in Basic/Toon modes.

_USE_VAT_ON.label: Enable Vertex Animation Texture
_USE_VAT_ON.tooltip: Applies baked vertex animation from a VAT texture. Used for pre-baked cloth, fluid, or destruction effects.

_VATPositionTex.label: VAT Position Texture
_VATPositionTex.tooltip: The VAT position offset texture. Each row is a frame.

_VATFrameCount.label: Frame Count
_VATFrameCount.tooltip: Total number of animation frames in the texture.

_VATSpeed.label: Speed
_VATSpeed.tooltip: Playback speed of the vertex animation.

_USE_WETNESS_ON.label: Enable Wetness
_USE_WETNESS_ON.tooltip: Simulates a wet surface with darkening and rain ripple effects.

_WetnessSmoothness.label: Wet Smoothness
_WetnessSmoothness.tooltip: Smoothness boost for wet surfaces (affects specular highlight sharpness).

_WetnessDarkening.label: Darkening
_WetnessDarkening.tooltip: How much the surface darkens when wet.

_RainRippleMap.label: Rain Ripple Normal Map
_RainRippleMap.tooltip: Normal map used for rain ripple animation.

_RainRippleScale.label: Ripple Scale
_RainRippleScale.tooltip: Scale of the rain ripple pattern.

_RainRippleSpeed.label: Ripple Speed
_RainRippleSpeed.tooltip: Speed of the rain ripple animation.

_DecalTex.label: Decal Texture
_DecalTex.tooltip: The decal texture. Use tiling/offset to position it.

_DecalBlendMode.label: Blend Mode
_DecalBlendMode.tooltip: How the decal blends with the base color.

_DecalNormalStrength.label: Normal Strength
_DecalNormalStrength.tooltip: Strength of the decal normal map.

_DecalMetallic.label: Metallic
_DecalMetallic.tooltip: Metallic value for the decal area.

_DecalSmoothness.label: Smoothness
_DecalSmoothness.tooltip: Smoothness value for the decal area.

_UseHologram.label: Use Hologram
_UseHologram.tooltip: Sci-fi hologram effect with animated scanlines, edge rim, and flicker.

_HoloColor.label: Hologram Color
_HoloColor.tooltip: Color tint of the hologram projection.

_HoloRimPower.label: Rim Power
_HoloRimPower.tooltip: Falloff sharpness of the hologram edge glow.

_HoloStrength.label: Hologram Strength
_HoloStrength.tooltip: Blend strength of hologram over base surface.

_UseCustomFogColor.label: Enable Custom Fog Color
_UseCustomFogColor.tooltip: Overrides the global scene fog color with a custom localized tint.

_CustomFogColor.label: Custom Fog Color
_CustomFogColor.tooltip: Custom tint color for atmospheric fog.

_AlphaToCoverage.label: Alpha to Coverage (MSAA)
_AlphaToCoverage.tooltip: Enables hardware Alpha to Coverage (MSAA anti-aliasing) on cutout edges, smoothing foliage and hair.

_AlphaToCoverageSharpen.label: A2C Sharpen
_AlphaToCoverageSharpen.tooltip: Sharpens the Alpha to Coverage edges.

_ShadowReceiveStrength.label: Shadow Receive Strength
_ShadowReceiveStrength.tooltip: Controls how dark real-time scene shadows appear on the material (1.0 = full shadow, 0.0 = no shadow).

_DecalClamp.label: Clamp Decal Bounds
_DecalClamp.tooltip: Clamps decal UV coordinates so the decal does not repeat outside [0, 1].

_Decal2Clamp.label: Clamp Decal Bounds
_Decal2Clamp.tooltip: Clamps decal UV coordinates so Decal 2 does not repeat outside [0, 1].

_Decal3Clamp.label: Clamp Decal Bounds
_Decal3Clamp.tooltip: Clamps decal UV coordinates so Decal 3 does not repeat outside [0, 1].

_RimMask.label: Rim Mask
_RimMask.tooltip: Texture mask (R) to restrict or paint out rim glow on specific mesh areas.

_RimMaskUVSet.label: Rim Mask UV Set
_RimMaskUVSet.tooltip: Selects coordinate channel (UV0 or UV1) for the Rim Mask.

_OutlineLightingMix.label: Lighting Mix
_OutlineLightingMix.tooltip: Blends scene lighting onto the outline (0 = unlit, 1 = fully shaded by scene lights).

_OutlineZOffset.label: Z-Offset (Depth Bias)
_OutlineZOffset.tooltip: Applies a camera-space Z-depth bias to prevent outlines from clipping adjacent geometry.

_UseFaceSDF.label: Enable SDF Face Shadows
_UseFaceSDF.tooltip: Signed Distance Field face shadow mapping for anime characters.

_FaceShadowMap.label: Face Shadow Map (SDF)
_FaceShadowMap.tooltip: SDF Face Shadow texture encoding light threshold gradients.

_FaceShadowOffset.label: Face Shadow Offset
_FaceShadowOffset.tooltip: Offsets the front/back shadow threshold angle.

_FaceShadowBlur.label: Face Shadow Softness
_FaceShadowBlur.tooltip: Softens the SDF shadow edge boundary.

_CameraVisibilityMode.label: Visibility Mode
_CameraVisibilityMode.tooltip: Controls visibility in mirrors, VR headset, and desktop stream/photo cameras.

_CustomCameraFilter.label: Custom Camera ID
_CustomCameraFilter.tooltip: Filter by custom global camera ID (0 = disabled).

_UseEnvRim.label: Environmental Rim
_UseEnvRim.tooltip: Tints/modulates the rim glow using ambient SH and reflection probes.

_EnvRimMix.label: Environmental Mix
_EnvRimMix.tooltip: Blend between pure rim color (0) and environment-modulated rim (1).

_MonochromeLighting.label: Monochrome Lighting
_MonochromeLighting.tooltip: Desaturates scene lighting color to preserve accurate character skin tones.

_AsUnlitLighting.label: As-Unlit Lighting
_AsUnlitLighting.tooltip: Blends lighting towards a uniform unlit floor in dark environments.

_UseVRCLV.label: VRC Light Volumes
_UseVRCLV.tooltip: Samples VRC Light Volumes (REDSIM) for per-pixel ambient lighting in supported worlds. Falls back to standard light probes elsewhere. Forced OFF in Medium/Low performance levels.

_VRCLVIntensity.label: LV Intensity
_VRCLVIntensity.tooltip: Scales the light volume ambient contribution.

_VRCLVNormalBias.label: LV Normal Bias
_VRCLVNormalBias.tooltip: Offsets the volume sample along the surface normal to reduce voxel acne on thin geometry.

_UseFluorescence.label: Enable Fluorescence
_UseFluorescence.tooltip: Reactions with environmental/directional light intensity (glows in the dark).

_FluorescenceMapUVSet.label: Fluorescence Map UV Set
_FluorescenceMapUVSet.tooltip: Selects coordinate channel (UV0 or UV1) for fluorescence map.

_FluorescenceThreshold.label: Light Threshold
_FluorescenceThreshold.tooltip: Light level threshold triggering fluorescence glow.

_FluorescenceHardness.label: Hardness
_FluorescenceHardness.tooltip: Transition sharpness between dark and lit state.

_FluorescenceDarkOnly.label: Glow Only in Dark
_FluorescenceDarkOnly.tooltip: When enabled, only glows in low-light environments (glow-in-the-dark).

_UsePS1VertexSnapping.label: Enable PS1 Vertex Snapping
_UsePS1VertexSnapping.tooltip: Quantizes vertex positions to a low-resolution grid for a retro PS1 / affine jitter aesthetic.

_PS1SnapResolution.label: Snap Resolution
_PS1SnapResolution.tooltip: Grid resolution / precision for vertex snapping (e.g. 240p).

_PS1SnapSpace.label: Snap Space
_PS1SnapSpace.tooltip: Coordinate space for snapping (Screen-space jitter vs Object-space vertex quantize).

_UseLookAt.label: Enable LookAt Billboarding
_UseLookAt.tooltip: Rotates mesh vertices to dynamically face the active camera.

_LookAtMode.label: Billboard Mode
_LookAtMode.tooltip: Billboarding orientation axis (Full 3D spherical billboard vs Y-Axis cylindrical billboard).

_LookAtStrength.label: Strength
_LookAtStrength.tooltip: Blend strength between original mesh orientation and billboarded orientation.

_UseUVFlow.label: Enable UV Flow
_UseUVFlow.tooltip: Animates textures along vector flow map paths using seamless 2-phase cycling.

_FlowMapUVSet.label: Flow Map UV Set
_FlowMapUVSet.tooltip: Selects coordinate channel (UV0 or UV1) for flow map.

_FlowStrength.label: Flow Strength
_FlowStrength.tooltip: Magnitude of UV distortion displacement along flow vectors.

_UseRGBAColorMask.label: Enable RGBA Color Masking
_UseRGBAColorMask.tooltip: Permits 4 independent color tints and emissive channels mapped to RGBA channels of a mask texture.

_RGBAColorMask.label: Color Mask (RGBA)
_RGBAColorMask.tooltip: Color Mask (RGBA channels isolate 4 recolorable zones)

_RGBAColorMaskUVSet.label: UV Set
_RGBAColorMaskUVSet.tooltip: Selects coordinate channel (UV0 or UV1) for RGBA Color Mask.

_UseNetworkTime.label: Enable Network-Synced Time
_UseNetworkTime.tooltip: Synchronizes shader continuous animation time across network clients via AudioLink/Udon chronological clock (prevents animation drift in VRChat).

_NetworkTimeScale.label: Network Time Scale
_NetworkTimeScale.tooltip: Scale factor applied to network synced time.

_UseStochasticSampling.label: Enable Stochastic Sampling
_UseStochasticSampling.tooltip: Procedurally blends randomized texture samples to completely eliminate repeating tiling patterns on large surfaces.

_StochasticScale.label: Stochastic Scale
_StochasticScale.tooltip: Scale multiplier for stochastic triangular lattice distribution.

_UseDetailNormalFade.label: Enable Detail Normal Distance Fade
_UseDetailNormalFade.tooltip: Smoothly fades out high-frequency detail normals at distance to prevent VR aliasing/shimmering.

_DetailNormalFadeStart.label: Fade Start Distance
_DetailNormalFadeStart.tooltip: Camera distance where detail normals start fading out.

_DetailNormalFadeEnd.label: Fade End Distance
_DetailNormalFadeEnd.tooltip: Camera distance where detail normals are completely flat.

_UseInternalParallax.label: Enable Internal Parallax
_UseInternalParallax.tooltip: Simulates layered interior depth beneath glass, lenses, crystals, and anime irises.

_InternalParallaxColor_Shift.label: Internal Parallax Color Shift
_InternalParallaxColor_Shift.tooltip: AudioLink or animated color shift for internal layered parallax effect.

_InternalParallaxLayers.label: Sample Steps
_InternalParallaxLayers.tooltip: Number of sample steps through interior depth.

_InternalParallaxEmission.label: Emissive Boost
_InternalParallaxEmission.tooltip: Emissive glow boost for internal layers.

_UseThemeColors.label: Enable Global Theme Colors
_UseThemeColors.tooltip: Defines 4 global master colors to drive unified themes across materials, with optional AudioLink and Hue modulation.

_ThemeMode.label: Modulation Mode
_ThemeMode.tooltip: Selects modulation mode (Direct, AudioLink Reactive, or Continuous Hue Shift).

_AL_ThemeBand.label: AudioLink Band
_AL_ThemeBand.tooltip: Selects frequency band driving theme modulation.

_ThemeShiftSpeed.label: Hue Shift Speed
_ThemeShiftSpeed.tooltip: Speed of continuous hue shift rotation.

_ThemeTargetMask.label: Theme Target Mask
_ThemeTargetMask.tooltip: Influence weights: R=Base Color, G=Outlines, B=Rim, A=Emission.

_UseCustomCubemap.label: Enable Custom Cubemap
_UseCustomCubemap.tooltip: Adds a custom cubemap for local reflections or fallback when reflection probes are missing/dark.

_CustomCubemapRoughness.label: Roughness
_CustomCubemapRoughness.tooltip: Roughness / blur of the cubemap reflection.

_CustomCubemapMode.label: Blend Mode
_CustomCubemapMode.tooltip: Mode (Override Probes, Fallback When Probes Dark, or Additive).

_AL_DelayBass.label: Bass Delay
_AL_DelayBass.tooltip: Delay offset along history buffer for Bass.

_AL_DelayLowMid.label: Low Mid Delay
_AL_DelayLowMid.tooltip: Delay offset along history buffer for Low Mid.

_AL_DelayHighMid.label: High Mid Delay
_AL_DelayHighMid.tooltip: Delay offset along history buffer for High Mid.

_AL_DelayTreble.label: Treble Delay
_AL_DelayTreble.tooltip: Delay offset along history buffer for Treble.

_UseLTCGI.label: Enable LTCGI
_UseLTCGI.tooltip: Reacts to real-time LTCGI polygonal area lights and video screens in supported VRChat worlds.

_LTCGI_Intensity.label: Intensity
_LTCGI_Intensity.tooltip: Intensity multiplier of LTCGI area lighting.

_LTCGI_RoughnessMultiplier.label: Roughness Multiplier
_LTCGI_RoughnessMultiplier.tooltip: Roughness scale factor for LTCGI reflections.

_PhotosensitivitySafety.label: Photosensitivity Strobe Clamp
_PhotosensitivitySafety.tooltip: Safety clamp limiting maximum strobe/flash frequency to safeguard against epileptic seizures.

_MaxFlashFrequency.label: Max Flash Hz
_MaxFlashFrequency.tooltip: Maximum allowed flashing/oscillation frequency in Hz.

_UseFur.label: Enable Shell Fur
_UseFur.tooltip: Extrudes multiple layered shell passes outward along vertex normals with strand noise masking.

_FurLayers.label: Shell Layers
_FurLayers.tooltip: Number of shell layers extruded (1 to 8). Higher layer counts produce fuller fur but cost more GPU geometry rasterization.

_FurLength.label: Length
_FurLength.tooltip: Physical length of the fur strands in object/world space.

_FurMaskTex.label: Fur Strand Noise Map
_FurMaskTex.tooltip: Noise texture controlling strand distribution and density.

_FurDensity.label: Strand Density
_FurDensity.tooltip: Tiling density of the fur strand noise pattern.

_FurThinning.label: Tip Thinning
_FurThinning.tooltip: Progressively thins and tapers fur strands towards the outer tips.

_FurGravity.label: Gravity Vector
_FurGravity.tooltip: Deflection vector simulating gravity pulling fur strands downward.

_FurWindStrength.label: Wind Sway Strength
_FurWindStrength.tooltip: Strength of procedural wind oscillation across the fur tips.

_FurRootColor.label: Root Tint
_FurRootColor.tooltip: Color tint at the base/root of each fur strand.

_FurTipColor.label: Tip Tint
_FurTipColor.tooltip: Color tint at the outer tip of each fur strand.

_FurAO.label: Root AO Shadow
_FurAO.tooltip: Simulates ambient occlusion shadowing at the root of the fur.

_FurCutoff.label: Strand Cutoff
_FurCutoff.tooltip: Base alpha clipping threshold for strand root thickness.

_AlphaToCoverageMipScale.label: A2C Mip Scale
_AlphaToCoverageMipScale.tooltip: Derivative-based mip-scaling to stabilize cutout edge width across distances in VR.

_DetailNormalBicubic.label: Bicubic Normal Filtering
_DetailNormalBicubic.tooltip: Enables 5-tap Catmull-Rom bicubic sampling to eliminate texel boundary artifacts in VR.

_DetailNormal2Scale.label: Layer 2 Strength
_DetailNormal2Scale.tooltip: Controls the strength of detail normal layer 2.

_DetailNormal2ScrollX.label: Layer 2 Scroll Speed X
_DetailNormal2ScrollX.tooltip: Scroll speed X for detail normal layer 2.

_DetailNormal2ScrollY.label: Layer 2 Scroll Speed Y
_DetailNormal2ScrollY.tooltip: Scroll speed Y for detail normal layer 2.

_DetailNormal3Scale.label: Layer 3 Strength
_DetailNormal3Scale.tooltip: Controls the strength of detail normal layer 3.

_DetailNormal3ScrollX.label: Layer 3 Scroll Speed X
_DetailNormal3ScrollX.tooltip: Scroll speed X for detail normal layer 3.

_DetailNormal3ScrollY.label: Layer 3 Scroll Speed Y
_DetailNormal3ScrollY.tooltip: Scroll speed Y for detail normal layer 3.

_DetailNormal4Scale.label: Layer 4 Strength
_DetailNormal4Scale.tooltip: Controls the strength of detail normal layer 4.

_DetailNormal4ScrollX.label: Layer 4 Scroll Speed X
_DetailNormal4ScrollX.tooltip: Scroll speed X for detail normal layer 4.

_DetailNormal4ScrollY.label: Layer 4 Scroll Speed Y
_DetailNormal4ScrollY.tooltip: Scroll speed Y for detail normal layer 4.

_UseOKLabBlending.label: OKLab Color Blending
_UseOKLabBlending.tooltip: Enables Björn Ottosson's OKLab color space blending for tints and themes to eliminate muddy desaturation.

_UseVRSL.label: Enable VRSL Reception
_UseVRSL.tooltip: Reacts to real-time DMX stage fixtures, lasers, and volumetric club lighting in supported VRChat worlds.

_VRSLIntensity.label: GI Intensity
_VRSLIntensity.tooltip: GI and ambient wash reception intensity.

_VRSLSpecular.label: Specular Reception
_VRSLSpecular.tooltip: Specular highlight reflection reception from fixtures.

_UseDebugMode.label: Enable Debug View
_UseDebugMode.tooltip: Inspect intermediate shading buffers and diagnostics in viewport.

Animate.label: Animate
Animate.tooltip: Automatically animates the collapse amount over time.

Custom Shadow Cutoff.label: Custom Shadow Cutoff
Custom Shadow Cutoff.tooltip: Overrides the alpha cutoff threshold specifically for shadow casting passes.

Enable Advanced Animation Controls.label: Enable Advanced Animation Controls
Enable Advanced Animation Controls.tooltip: Exposes master controls for time scaling, playback mode, and time offset for all shader animations.

Enable Anisotropic Reflection.label: Enable Anisotropic Reflection
Enable Anisotropic Reflection.tooltip: Creates stretched highlights, common on brushed metal or hair.

Enable Back Face Color.label: Enable Back Face Color
Enable Back Face Color.tooltip: Applies a separate color to back-facing polygons.

Enable Back Face Texture.label: Enable Back Face Texture
Enable Back Face Texture.tooltip: Applies a separate texture to back-facing polygons.

Enable Chroma Keying.label: Enable Chroma Keying
Enable Chroma Keying.tooltip: Makes a specific color range transparent (e.g. green-screen keying).

Enable Clear Coat.label: Enable Clear Coat
Enable Clear Coat.tooltip: Adds a secondary clear coat specular layer over the base PBR material. Useful for painted/coated surfaces.

Enable Clipping Mask.label: Enable Clipping Mask
Enable Clipping Mask.tooltip: Uses a texture to clip (make parts invisible) of the material. This is a hard clip, not soft transparency.

Enable Custom Cubemap Reflection.label: Enable Custom Cubemap Reflection
Enable Custom Cubemap Reflection.tooltip: Adds a custom cubemap for local reflections or fallback when reflection probes are missing/dark.

Enable Custom Fog Color.label: Enable Custom Fog Color
Enable Custom Fog Color.tooltip: Overrides the global scene fog color with a custom localized tint.

Enable Depth Fade (Soft Particles).label: Enable Depth Fade (Soft Particles)
Enable Depth Fade (Soft Particles).tooltip: Softens polygon intersections against scene geometry for transparent and additive surfaces.

Enable Detail Normal Distance Fade.label: Enable Detail Normal Distance Fade
Enable Detail Normal Distance Fade.tooltip: Smoothly fades out high-frequency detail normals at distance to prevent VR aliasing/shimmering.

Enable Detail Normal Map.label: Enable Detail Normal Map
Enable Detail Normal Map.tooltip: Adds a secondary normal map for micro-surface detail bumps.

Enable Detail Texture.label: Enable Detail Texture
Enable Detail Texture.tooltip: Overlays a secondary texture, often for fine detail or grunge.

Enable Dissolve.label: Enable Dissolve
Enable Dissolve.tooltip: Makes the object appear/disappear using a noise pattern.

Enable Distance Fade.label: Enable Distance Fade
Enable Distance Fade.tooltip: Fades the object out when it’s far from the camera.

Enable Dithered Transparency.label: Enable Dithered Transparency
Enable Dithered Transparency.tooltip: Screen-space Bayer matrix dithering for sorting-free transparent fabrics and hair.

Enable Effect Distance Fade (LOD).label: Enable Effect Distance Fade (LOD)
Enable Effect Distance Fade (LOD).tooltip: Fades heavy procedural effects (Glitter, Fractals, Grid, Psychedelic) beyond a set distance to improve VR performance.

Enable Emission.label: Enable Emission
Enable Emission.tooltip: Makes the object glow. Requires a Bloom post-processing effect in the scene to see the glow.

Enable Emission Bloom Clamp.label: Enable Emission Bloom Clamp
Enable Emission Bloom Clamp.tooltip: Clamps maximum HDR luminance of emission to prevent blinding bloom whiteouts.

Enable Emission Pulse.label: Enable Emission Pulse
Enable Emission Pulse.tooltip: Pulses emission intensity rhythmically without affecting diffuse lighting.

Enable Environment Reflections.label: Enable Environment Reflections
Enable Environment Reflections.tooltip: Samples reflection probes to add environmental reflections, even in Basic/Toon modes.

Enable Eye Iris Parallax.label: Enable Eye Iris Parallax
Enable Eye Iris Parallax.tooltip: Simulates depth/refraction of the pupil and iris beneath the cornea.

Enable Flipbook Animation.label: Enable Flipbook Animation
Enable Flipbook Animation.tooltip: Animates the main texture using a spritesheet layout. This will override the main texture’s tiling and offset.

Enable Fluorescence.label: Enable Fluorescence
Enable Fluorescence.tooltip: Reactions with environmental/directional light intensity (glows in the dark).

Enable Fourth Emission.label: Enable Fourth Emission
Enable Fourth Emission.tooltip: Adds a fourth scrolling emission layer.

Enable Fresnel Transparency.label: Enable Fresnel Transparency
Enable Fresnel Transparency.tooltip: Makes the object more transparent in the center and opaque at the edges.

Enable Glitch Flicker.label: Enable Glitch Flicker
Enable Glitch Flicker.tooltip: Applies a flickering effect to the whole object.

Enable Global Theme Colors.label: Enable Global Theme Colors
Enable Global Theme Colors.tooltip: Defines 4 global master colors to drive unified themes across materials, with optional AudioLink and Hue modulation.

Enable Grid.label: Enable Grid
Enable Grid.tooltip: Overlays a grid pattern on the surface.

Enable Hair Specular (Kajiya-Kay).label: Enable Hair Specular (Kajiya-Kay)
Enable Hair Specular (Kajiya-Kay).tooltip: Anisotropic highlights styled specifically for hair strands.

Enable Hologram.label: Enable Hologram
Enable Hologram.tooltip: Sci-fi hologram effect with animated scanlines, edge rim, and flicker.

Enable HSV Mask.label: Enable HSV Mask
Enable HSV Mask.tooltip: Mask HSV adjustments using a texture map.

Enable Interlacing.label: Enable Interlacing
Enable Interlacing.tooltip: Darkens every other screen row to simulate an interlaced display.

Enable Internal Parallax (Gems / Eye Lay.label: Enable Internal Parallax (Gems / Eye Layers)
Enable Internal Parallax (Gems / Eye Lay.tooltip: Simulates layered interior depth beneath glass, lenses, crystals, and anime irises.

Enable Intersection Effect.label: Enable Intersection Effect
Enable Intersection Effect.tooltip: Fades to a color where the object is close to or intersects with other objects in the scene.

Enable LookAt Billboarding.label: Enable LookAt Billboarding
Enable LookAt Billboarding.tooltip: Rotates mesh vertices to dynamically face the active camera.

Enable LTCGI (Area Light GI).label: Enable LTCGI (Area Light GI)
Enable LTCGI (Area Light GI).tooltip: Reacts to real-time LTCGI polygonal area lights and video screens in supported VRChat worlds.

Enable MatCap 2.label: Enable MatCap 2
Enable MatCap 2.tooltip: Adds a secondary MatCap layer for multi-tone metallic or rim accents.

Enable Near Camera Fade.label: Enable Near Camera Fade
Enable Near Camera Fade.tooltip: Smoothly dissolves geometry when the camera gets too close (prevents VR head clipping).

Enable Network-Synced Time.label: Enable Network-Synced Time
Enable Network-Synced Time.tooltip: Synchronizes shader continuous animation time across network clients via AudioLink/Udon chronological clock (prevents animation drift in VRChat).

Enable Outline.label: Enable Outline
Enable Outline.tooltip: Adds a solid outline around the object. This adds a second draw call to the object.

Enable Outline Gradient.label: Enable Outline Gradient
Enable Outline Gradient.tooltip: Applies a vertical top/bottom gradient across the outline.

Enable Parallax Mapping (Height Map).label: Enable Parallax Mapping (Height Map)
Enable Parallax Mapping (Height Map).tooltip: Uses a height map to offset UVs for depth.

Enable Parallax Occlusion Mapping.label: Enable Parallax Occlusion Mapping
Enable Parallax Occlusion Mapping.tooltip: Enables multi-step parallax for higher quality depth effect. High perf only.

Enable Planar Wipe.label: Enable Planar Wipe
Enable Planar Wipe.tooltip: Reveals the object with a smooth, directional wipe.

Enable Posterization.label: Enable Posterization
Enable Posterization.tooltip: Reduces the number of colors, giving a retro/digital look.

Enable Procedural Texture.label: Enable Procedural Texture
Enable Procedural Texture.tooltip: Replaces a material property with a generated pattern.

Enable Proximity Effect.label: Enable Proximity Effect
Enable Proximity Effect.tooltip: Triggers visual effects (glow, dissolve, dither, or tint) based on distance to the camera, object pivot, or custom world position.

Enable PS1 Retro Vertex Snapping.label: Enable PS1 Retro Vertex Snapping
Enable PS1 Retro Vertex Snapping.tooltip: Quantizes vertex positions to a low-resolution grid for a retro PS1 / affine jitter aesthetic.

Enable Pulse.label: Enable Pulse
Enable Pulse.tooltip: Adds a pulsing animation to the emission strength.

Enable RGBA Color Masking (Recolor Workf.label: Enable RGBA Color Masking (Recolor Workflow)
Enable RGBA Color Masking (Recolor Workf.tooltip: Permits 4 independent color tints and emissive channels mapped to RGBA channels of a mask texture.

Enable Rim Glow.label: Enable Rim Glow
Enable Rim Glow.tooltip: Adds a glow to the edges of the object based on viewing angle.

Enable Ripple Effect.label: Enable Ripple Effect
Enable Ripple Effect.tooltip: Creates a concentric ripple effect emanating from a UV coordinate.

Enable Scanlines.label: Enable Scanlines
Enable Scanlines.tooltip: Simulates the look of a CRT monitor.

Enable Screen Refraction.label: Enable Screen Refraction
Enable Screen Refraction.tooltip: Distorts the screen behind the object.

Enable SDF Face Shadows.label: Enable SDF Face Shadows
Enable SDF Face Shadows.tooltip: Signed Distance Field face shadow mapping for anime characters.

Enable Second Emission.label: Enable Second Emission
Enable Second Emission.tooltip: Adds a second scrolling emission layer.

Enable Shader Debug View.label: Enable Shader Debug View
Enable Shader Debug View.tooltip: Inspect intermediate shading buffers and diagnostics in viewport.

Enable Shell Fur.label: Enable Shell Fur
Enable Shell Fur.tooltip: Extrudes multiple layered shell passes outward along vertex normals with strand noise masking.

Enable Skin Diffuse Wrap.label: Enable Skin Diffuse Wrap
Enable Skin Diffuse Wrap.tooltip: Softens lighting shadows on organic curved surfaces.

Enable Step Specular.label: Enable Step Specular
Enable Step Specular.tooltip: Converts soft PBR specular highlights into crisp cartoon shine spots.

Enable Stochastic Sampling.label: Enable Stochastic Sampling
Enable Stochastic Sampling.tooltip: Procedurally blends randomized texture samples to completely eliminate repeating tiling patterns on large surfaces.

Enable Subsurface Scattering.label: Enable Subsurface Scattering
Enable Subsurface Scattering.tooltip: Simulates light scattering through thin objects like skin or leaves.

Enable Thickness Map.label: Enable Thickness Map
Enable Thickness Map.tooltip: Uses a texture to simulate light transmission through thin areas (ears, leaves, etc.).

Enable Third Emission.label: Enable Third Emission
Enable Third Emission.tooltip: Adds a third scrolling emission layer.

Enable Transparency Glitch.label: Enable Transparency Glitch
Enable Transparency Glitch.tooltip: Causes the flicker effect to also affect transparency.

Enable Triplanar Normal Map.label: Enable Triplanar Normal Map
Enable Triplanar Normal Map.tooltip: Projects a normal map across 3 axes.

Enable UV Distortion.label: Enable UV Distortion
Enable UV Distortion.tooltip: Uses a texture to warp the UV coordinates, creating effects like heat haze or water ripples.

Enable UV Flow (Pathing).label: Enable UV Flow (Pathing)
Enable UV Flow (Pathing).tooltip: Animates textures along vector flow map paths using seamless 2-phase cycling.

Enable UV Tile Discard.label: Enable UV Tile Discard
Enable UV Tile Discard.tooltip: Discard specific UV tiles. Useful for toggling clothing parts.

Enable Vertex Animation Texture.label: Enable Vertex Animation Texture
Enable Vertex Animation Texture.tooltip: Applies baked vertex animation from a VAT texture. Used for pre-baked cloth, fluid, or destruction effects.

Enable Vertex Collapse.label: Enable Vertex Collapse
Enable Vertex Collapse.tooltip: Shrinks the model into its center point.

Enable Video Player.label: Enable Video Player
Enable Video Player.tooltip: Configures the texture to receive video player data.

Enable VRSL (VRC Studio Lighting).label: Enable VRSL (VRC Studio Lighting)
Enable VRSL (VRC Studio Lighting).tooltip: Reacts to real-time DMX stage fixtures, lasers, and volumetric club lighting in supported VRChat worlds.

Enable Wetness.label: Enable Wetness
Enable Wetness.tooltip: Simulates a wet surface with darkening and rain ripple effects.

Override Scene Light.label: Override Scene Light
Override Scene Light.tooltip: Overrides the direction, color, and intensity of the main scene light.

Photosensitivity Strobe Clamp.label: Photosensitivity Strobe Clamp
Photosensitivity Strobe Clamp.tooltip: Safety clamp limiting maximum strobe/flash frequency to safeguard against epileptic seizures.

Use Auto Hue Shift.label: Use Auto Hue Shift
Use Auto Hue Shift.tooltip: Continuously shifts the fractal base color over time.

Use Depth-Based Color.label: Use Depth-Based Color
Use Depth-Based Color.tooltip: Changes the grid color based on its proximity to other surfaces.

Use Emission Mask.label: Use Emission Mask
Use Emission Mask.tooltip: Uses a texture to control which parts of the surface emit light.

Use Grid Mask.label: Use Grid Mask
Use Grid Mask.tooltip: Uses a texture to mask the grid effect.

Use Outline Width Map.label: Use Outline Width Map
Use Outline Width Map.tooltip: Uses a greyscale texture to modulate outline thickness per-pixel.

Use Texture Alpha for Emission.label: Use Texture Alpha for Emission
Use Texture Alpha for Emission.tooltip: Uses the main texture’s alpha channel as an emission map. A powerful way to create glow maps without a separate texture.

Use Transmission Texture.label: Use Transmission Texture
Use Transmission Texture.tooltip: Custom color map tinting the backlight transmission.
